verdict_reason: The provider-parameterised discovery fetch is correct, but nothing tests the IDM path's discovery URL or metric, so a regression to the Defra ID values would pass.

todos.issue: The new provider parameter (lines 10-13: discovery URL read from providerSetting(provider, 'oidcDiscoveryUrl') and the call measured as provider.calls.openidConfiguration) has no test that fails if it is reverted: get-oidc-config.test.js only calls getOidcConfig() with the Defra ID default, and verify-token.test.js:59 sets idm.oidcDiscoveryUrl equal to defraId.oidcDiscoveryUrl and asserts only the jwks metric, so hardcoding defraId.oidcDiscoveryUrl or DEFRA_ID_CALLS.openidConfiguration back would leave every test green.
todos.fix: Must: a test in get-oidc-config.test.js fails if getOidcConfig(idmProvider) fetches anything but the idm.oidcDiscoveryUrl or measures the call as anything but idm openid-configuration. One way: set idm.oidcDiscoveryUrl to a URL distinct from the Defra ID one, serve it with serveOidcDiscovery(doc, { discoveryUrlKey: idmOidcDiscoveryUrlKey }), call getOidcConfig(idmProvider), and assert the returned document plus the EMF Dependency 'idm' and Operation 'openid-configuration'.
